GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2-3l off, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, battled on strong to the line # no match 1,2
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast comf Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear challenged Turning for home dueled to 100m, # run ended 50m
Jumped Fast comf Went Forward Took sit 2nd 4 Lengths within 2 Lengths @ 400m had its chance couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
Jumped Ok landed box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, battled on one pace # box seat/kept on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Rolled fwd & raced narrow 2nd Two Wide early. Stayed 2nd Two Wide (1.5L from lead) midrace until pushed to quicken Five Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & weakened in straight. Vetted clear. # On-pace/weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that after beginning well, the mare travelled strongly outside the leader. She said that the mare initially responded well to her riding when placed under pressure near the 400m however weakened significantly from the 300m. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no significant abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Set  Good Pace , Joined Turning for home dueled to 200m, Couldn'T Go On Pace Suited Swoopers this was # weak once beat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr permitted to ride 1kg over the allotted weight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2nd 1l. Under Good Hold Outside Leader to Turn . =led into Straight but No Match to 200m. boxed on fairly behind them, No Match # pace, faded
Jumped Ok Straight To The Front from Outside but Took hold thus Settled Down 2nd Outside 1/2 Lengths Hard Ridden x 400 Held Ground to 300 Couldn'T Go On - # slow recovery
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the mare raced keenly when positioned outside the leader through the early and middle stages and, as a consequence, was left without a finishing effort and weakened noticeably over the final 250m. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to be slow to recover. Tnr advised the mare would now be spelled.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear of winner, challenged 400 sprint home dueled to 100m, then couldn't finish off had its chance - # led the winner
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr was permitted to ride 1kg over the allotted weight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly but Quickly Crossed Straight To The Front by 1.5l. controlled it midrace then slipped Clear to Turn . Straightened Up 3l Clear and Battled On Well . had a break and saw it out # led all the way
